Meet ConstBooth

ConstBooth is a free online photo booth to take photos together from anywhere. Create fun photo strips in real time with your long-distance partner, friends, or family.

Instant in your browser

No apps to download and no accounts to create. Open ConstBooth on any phone, tablet, or laptop and step into the booth in seconds.

Built for distance

Create a private room link and invite your partner or best friend anywhere in the world. Dual cameras snap side-by-side with synchronized countdown shutters.

Private by default

Photo processing and strip assembly happen locally on your device. Your private booth photos are never stored permanently on our servers or used for AI training.

Two ways to capture moments

Whether you are shooting solo or snapping with friends across cities, we have you covered.

Solo Booth

Capture and customize classic photo strips on your own with complete creative control.

  • Automatic 3-second countdown shutter
  • Vintage, retro film, and black & white filters
  • Instant high-resolution strip and frame downloads
  • 100% free with no app or account required
Start Solo Booth→

Shared Booth

Invite a friend or loved one anywhere in the world to capture side-by-side memories in real time.

  • One-click private room invite link
  • Synchronized dual-camera countdown shutter
  • Live side-by-side photo booth session
  • Combined shared strip for both of you
Start Shared Booth→

What you can create

Choose between classic multi-frame vertical photo strips and modern instant card layouts.

Vertical Photo Strips

The iconic photo booth keepsake. Create classic 3-frame or Korean 4-cut (Life4Cuts) photo strips. Pose through automated countdowns, pick from aesthetic designs like Vintage Postage, Retro Film, Denim Dreams, and Heartline, and export a print-ready strip file.

Explore all photo strip styles →

Instant Frames & Collages

Polaroid-style single and multi-photo card formats tailored for lockscreens, wallpapers, and social sharing. Choose from classic white-border single portraits, 2-photo stacks, 3-photo storyboards, or 4-photo 2x2 grid collage layouts.

Explore instant frame layouts →
Photo strip size guide →

Why choose ConstBooth

Designed to bring the fun of real photo booths to your browser with zero friction.

Pure browser native

Works in Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge on iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows. No app store downloads or device storage needed.

Real-time Shared Booth

Take photos with someone miles away. Dual cameras snap simultaneously with synchronized countdowns for genuine shared moments.

Private & device-local

Standard photo capture and strip compositing run locally in your browser. Photos are not permanently saved on our servers or trained on by AI.

Clean high-resolution export

Save your strips in crisp high resolution with zero watermarks, ready for digital keepsakes, wallpaper backgrounds, or home printing.

How it works

Four simple steps from opening your browser to downloading your keepsake.

1. Choose your booth

Pick Solo Booth to shoot alone, or create a Shared Booth and send the private invite link to a friend or partner.

2. Set up & pick a style

Allow camera access in your browser and choose your favorite aesthetic border style and color filter.

3. Pose for the countdown

Strike your poses as the automated countdown triggers each snapshot in sequence (synchronized in Shared Booth).

4. Save & print

Download your finished high-resolution photo strip instantly with no watermarks and no account needed.

Made for every moment

From long-distance dates to solo creative portraits, here is how people use ConstBooth.

Long-distance couples & virtual dates

Make date night feel close: pose together in the same photo strip, decorate a cozy 3D scene side by side, or leave a voice message for the morning, across any time zone.

Best friends across cities

Capture spontaneous photos, test funny poses, and save shared memories with friends wherever they are.

Parties, events & celebrations

Give guests a free, instant photo booth for birthdays, weddings, or virtual meetups without renting expensive hardware.

Solo keepsakes & aesthetic prints

Snap quick outfit checks, creative portraits, or print-ready photo strips for journals and phone cases in seconds.

Questions? We've got answers.

Everything you need to know about creating, sharing, and saving with ConstBooth.

ConstBooth is a free online photo booth for taking pictures together from anywhere. Whether you're capturing solo memories, connecting with a long-distance partner, or hanging out with friends miles apart, you can step into the same virtual booth and create timeless photo strips and instant frame collages in real time.

Yes. ConstBooth is 100% free to use. There are no subscriptions, no paywalls, no hidden fees, and zero watermarks added to your downloaded photo strips or instant cards.

No app installation is required. ConstBooth runs directly in any modern browser on mobile, tablet, or desktop. You can start shooting immediately as a guest without creating an account. Optional Google Sign-In is available if you want to sync, manage, and back up your saved photo strips across devices. Camera access is handled safely via standard browser media permissions.

When you start a Shared Booth, ConstBooth generates a private room link and a 6-character code (e.g. K8X4P2). Share either with your partner or friend. Once they join, both live camera feeds appear side-by-side, the countdown shutter synchronizes automatically in real time, and both of you receive the combined photo strip.

Yes. Privacy is built into our core architecture. For guest sessions, photo capture, vintage filter rendering, and strip assembly happen 100% locally on your device. We do not permanently store booth photos on our servers, and your photos are never used for AI training. If you sign in, your saved strips are stored securely in your private account. Read our Privacy Policy for full details.

Yes. Exported photo strips and instant cards are generated in ultra-crisp, high-resolution formats (300 DPI print-ready). They match standard 2×6 inch photobooth strip sizes and dimensions and 3×4 instant card sizes, making them perfect for home photo printers, print kiosks, or scrapbooks. Check out our guide on how to print photo strips at home.

ConstBooth works seamlessly on modern versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge across iOS (iPhone & iPad), Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux. No special hardware or plugins required.

You can create classic multi-frame vertical photo strips (3-frame and 4-frame) or choose Instant Frames with single portrait, 2-photo stack, 3-photo storyboard, and 4-photo collage layouts. Customize your creations with authentic retro film filters (B&W, Warm, Vintage, Pastel), custom frame border colors, stickers, and timestamps. Explore our creative photo strip ideas and photo booth pose ideas.

Yes. ConstBooth is great for weddings, birthdays, baby showers, long-distance date nights, and virtual meetups. Share a link or generate a QR code so guests can join directly from their own phones and capture memories instantly. Learn more in our guide on how to host a virtual photo booth party.

Yes. ConstBooth is a popular free online alternative to Korean Life4Cuts booths. You can capture classic 4-frame vertical strips, customize with pastel and vintage border designs, apply retro film filters, and download high-resolution 300 DPI strips ready for phone cases, scrapbooks, or printing at home.

Yes. In addition to multi-frame strips, you can select Instant Frames to generate classic Polaroid-style photos with iconic white borders, vintage film filters, and custom timestamps in single-photo, 2-photo stack, 3-photo story, or 2x2 collage layouts.

ConstBooth Letters is a free digital love letter maker. Write your message directly on the page, add photos or photo strips, include a date, location and small decorations, then fold the letter and place it in an envelope before sharing it. No account needed - open Letters to start.

ConstBooth Cassette lets you record an actual voice message onto a digital cassette. Customize the cover and label, add one photo, write a short note, then record, preview and re-record until it sounds right. The receiver watches the cassette slide into a player before it plays. Try ConstBooth Cassette.
